verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports describe GitLab's own GitHub importer bringing over repository data, issues, pull requests, and review comments, with cross-references preserved, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is community-only and covers GitHub as the only source platform. missing for 10: first-party importer documentation, evidence for source platforms other than GitHub, explicit confirmation that general (non-review) issue/PR comments are imported.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can import repositories from another hosting platform along with their issues, pull requests, reviews, and comments

citations.quote: the GitHub importer brings over repo data, description, issues, pull requests, wiki pages, milestones, labels, release notes, review comments, cross-references and private/public visibility
The GitHub importer brings over repo data, issues, pull requests, wikis, milestones, labels, release notes, review comments, and preserves cross-references and private/public visibility.
